d: In the area of the Grail forest, shady and serious, but not dark rocky ground. A clearing in the middle. To the left the path to the Gralsburg is assumed. To the middle of the background the ground descends to a deeper forest lake. Daybreak. - Gurnemanz (graciously old) and two squires (of tender young age) are stored sleeping under a tree - From the left side, as from the Gralsburg, the solemn morning wake-up call of the trumpets sounds.

Gradually, as Gurnemanz and Parsifal seem to walk, the stage, from left to right, transforms into imperceptibly: the forest disappears; in rock walls a gate opens, which now includes the two; then they become visible again in ascending corridors, which they seem to ride through. Long-held trombone sounds swell gently: approaching bells ringing. Finally, they have arrived in a powerful hall, which penetrates upwards into a high vaulted dome, through which only the light is lost. From the height above the dome one hears growing ringing.

Klingsor's Magic Shloss. In the inner recess of a tower open upwards. Stone steps lead to the rim of the tower wall; darkness in the depth after which it descends from the promontory of the wall that the ground represents.

It sinks quickly with the whole tower; at the same time, the magic garden rises and fills the stage completely. Tropical vegetation, the most luxuriant floral splendour; after the background to demarcation by the pinnacles of the castle wall, to which sideways protrudes of the castle building itself, [Arab rich style] lean with terraces. On the wall stands Parsifal, astonishingly looking down into the garden. - From all sides, first out of the garden, then out of the palace, we fall into confusion, individually, then at the same time always several beautiful girls: they are covered with fleetingly overturned, delicately colored veils, as they are just startled out of sleep.

In the area of the Grales Freie, graceful spring area with a gently rising flower meadow after the background. The foreground is occupied by the hem of the forest, which extends to the right, on rising rock bottom. In the foreground, on the forest side, a spring; opposite it, a little deeper, a simple hermit's hut, leaning against a rock block. Early morning. (Gurnemanz, aged to the high old age, as a hermit, dressed only in the shirt of the Grail Knight poorly, steps out of the hut and listens)

Gurnemanz has brought in his Grail Knight's coat; he and Kundry dress Parsifal with it. Parsifal solemnly seizes the spear and follows with Kundry slowly the guiding Gurnemanz. - The area changes very gradually, similarly as in the first elevator, only from right to left. After the three remained visible for a time, they disappear completely, as the forest loses itself more and more, and, on the other hand, rock vaults move closer. In vaulted corridors, always appreciable ringing. The rock walls open and the large Grail Hall, as in the first elevators, only without the dining tables, presents itself again. - Dark lighting. - From one side, the Titurel's corpse in the coffin pulls in; from the other side, the Amfortas in the screenbed; in front of these, the veiled shrine with the "Grail" (sang of the knights during the procession)
